config.statusline.sh:
#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name')
cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')
used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // 0 | floor')
cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd')
branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)
printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m:\033[34m%s\033[0m (%s) | \033[35m%s\033[0m | ctx %s%% | $%s\n' "$(basename "$cwd")" "$cwd" "$branch" "$model" "$used" "$cost"
printf 'session %s\n' "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id')"
